title: Isotope Sample Preparation of Diatoms for Paleoenvironmental Research
author: George Swann
materials: Syphon off solution/suspended material. Fine material in suspension will not contain diatoms and can be safely discarded.

steps.title: Initial Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Place up to 1 cm³ of freeze-dried sediment sample in a 10-12 ml centrifuge tube labeled with suffix 'A'. Adjust weight if the material is not freeze-dried.

steps.title: Initial Disaggregation
steps.instruction: Treat the sample with hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) in a fume cupboard at room temperature to break up aggregated sediment.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of 30% H₂O₂ and allow to react for 30 minutes; monitor for vigorous reactions and add deionised water if samples risk over-spilling.
Add a further 0.5 mL of 30% H₂O₂ and allow to react for 3 hours; monitor for vigorous reactions and add deionised water if necessary.

steps.title: Initial Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the sample with deionised water to remove reagents.

substeps.instruction: Fill the centrifuge tube to the top with deionised water, shake to combine, loosen lids to prevent gas build-up, and leave overnight in a fume cupboard.
Perform a second wash: fill tube to the top with deionised water, shake, and repeat the overnight process.
Perform a third wash: fill tube to the top with deionised water, shake, repeat the overnight process, and then syphon off as much water as possible.

steps.title: Prepare SPT Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sodium polytungstate (SPT) solution with a specific gravity of 2.25-2.30. Ensure the powder is fully dissolved and the solution is transparent. Wear a dust mask when handling dry SPT.

steps.title: First SPT Separation
steps.instruction: Separate diatoms from clays using SPT density separation.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL of SPT solution to tube 'A', shake to combine, and centrifuge at 2500 rpm for 20 minutes.
Label a second centrifuge tube as 'B'.
Add a small amount of deionised water to tube 'A', then use a 3 ml Pasteur pipette to transfer the supernate and SPT solution into tube 'B' without disturbing the precipitate.
Add another 4 mL of SPT solution to tube 'A', shake, and centrifuge at 2500 rpm for 20 minutes.
Transfer this second supernate into tube 'B' using the same method as above.
Fill tube 'B' to the top with deionised water, shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Syphon the liquid suspension from tube 'B' into SPT waste container #1.

steps.title: Second SPT Separation
steps.instruction: Perform a second density separation to further refine the sample.

substeps.instruction: Label a third centrifuge tube as 'C'.
Add 4 mL of SPT solution and 0.15 mL deionised water to tube 'B', shake, and centrifuge at 2500 rpm for 20 minutes.
Add a small amount of deionised water to tube 'B' and transfer the supernate into tube 'C' using a 3 ml Pasteur pipette.
Fill tube 'C' to the top with deionised water, shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Syphon the liquid suspension from tube 'C' into SPT waste container #1.

steps.title: Third SPT Separation
steps.instruction: Perform a third density separation to maximize purity.

substeps.instruction: Label a fourth centrifuge tube as 'D'.
Add 4 mL of SPT solution and 0.3 mL deionised water to tube 'C', shake, and centrifuge at 2500 rpm for 20 minutes.
Add a small amount of deionised water to tube 'C' and transfer the supernate into tube 'D' using a 3 ml Pasteur pipette.
Fill tube 'D' to the top with deionised water, shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Syphon the liquid suspension from tube 'D' into SPT waste container #1.

steps.title: Final Wash of Diatom Sample
steps.instruction: Clean the recovered diatoms in tube 'D'.

substeps.instruction: Fill tube 'D' to the top with deionised water, shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Repeat this wash a second time.

steps.title: Recovery of Non-Diatom Material
steps.instruction: Clean and recover non-diatom contaminants from tubes 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of deionised water to tubes 'A', 'B', and 'C', shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Syphon the liquid into SPT waste container #1.
Repeat these two steps twice more.

steps.title: Organic Matter Removal
steps.instruction: Remove external organic matter from the diatoms in tube 'D' using heat and H₂O₂.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL H₂O₂ to tube 'D' and shake to combine.
Loosen lids and place in a heat block/water bath at 75 °C in a fume cupboard for 168 hours (1 week), topping up H₂O₂ as necessary.
Allow samples to cool to room temperature, tighten lids, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Syphon off the solution, fill the tube to the top with deionised water, shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Repeat the final wash step twice.

steps.title: Carbonate Removal
steps.instruction: Remove trace levels of carbonate from the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 5% HCl to the top of the centrifuge tube, shake, and leave overnight at room temperature in a fume cupboard with lids loosened.
Fill the tube to the top with deionised water, shake, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Repeat the wash and centrifuge step twice more (for a total of three washes).

steps.title: Purity Assessment
steps.instruction: Evaluate sample purity before isotope analysis.

substeps.instruction: Perform initial assessment under a light or inverted microscope at ≥ x400 magnification.
If contaminated: perform additional clean-up (repeat 3rd SPT wash, differential settling, or sieving over a 0.45 μm cellulose nitrate membrane filter, or repeat organic removal).
If clean: perform further assessment using x1000 magnification, XRF (target Al/Si ratio ≤0.03, ideally ≤0.02), SEM, SEM-EDS, ICP-OES, or FTIR.

steps.title: SPT Waste Recovery
steps.instruction: Recycle the SPT solution from waste containers.

substeps.instruction: Sieve SPT from container #1 through a 5 μm cellulose membrane into container #2.
Sieve SPT from container #2 through a 1 μm cellulose membrane into container #3.
Sieve SPT from container #3 through a 0.45 μm cellulose membrane into container #4.
Place solution in an evaporating bowl in a drying cabinet (<105 °C) until dry, then grind for reuse, or monitor density until it reaches 2.25-2.30.
